title: Pantera en Masaya
style: Phonk with a sneaky half-time bounce, dusty cowbell ticks, warped sub pulses, and playful Latin percussion touches inspired by Nicaraguan street culture; verse rides tight with beatbox pockets and call-and-response backing singers as human instruments, pre-chorus narrows to handclaps and tongue clicks, chorus hits with stacked harmonies, gang shouts, and a sly panther motif. Vocal production uses close-mic lead, doubled punchlines, harmonized hook lines, and ad-lib panning. Ear candy includes reversed swells, whistle pops, and brief crowd-style chants. Mix is dark, punchy, and glossy with a comic grin., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[beatbox intro]
Tico step, suavecito
I slide like gato en tinaja
En la pulpería I wink
and the whole block start la raja

One eye on the plantain tray
one paw on the corner beat
I say “¿qué onda, maje?”
and they laugh at my sneaky feet

Bongo boca, boom-chá-chá
my tongue do the conga roll
I steal a grin from the crowd
then I bounce with the sugar bowl

(ajá)
(mirá)
(qué nivel)

[Pre-Chorus]
Shh, shh, no me veas
I’m under the mango shade
Sneak in bright like a panther
then I vanish in the parade

[Chorus]
Pantera, pantera
me muevo pa’ robar
Pantera, pantera
nadie me va a pillar

Pantera, pantera
con swing de barrio y sal
Pantera, pantera
me río y me voy ya

[Verse 2]
At the mercado I’m polished
but my mischief stay in line
I tap-dance past the tamales
with a joke and a lime

Abuela says “ven acá”
I say “ya voy, maybe not”
Then I ghost past the corner
like a rumor in the pot

Clap, clap, heel, toe
my whole crew sing along
One does bass with the chest
one does zap with the tongue

(boom)
(chá)
(maje, qué fino)

[Pre-Chorus]
Shh, shh, no me veas
I’m under the mango shade
Sneak in bright like a panther
then I vanish in the parade

[Chorus]
Pantera, pantera
me muevo pa’ robar
Pantera, pantera
nadie me va a pillar

Pantera, pantera
con swing de barrio y sal
Pantera, pantera
me río y me voy ya

[Bridge]
Beatbox breaks, hush now
I tiptoe through the laugh
Harmonic voice say “dale”
while the backing singers clap

Mango juice on my whiskers
and a grin that never quits
I’m the joke with soft paws
I’m the shadow that flirts

(ay, ay)
(qué chistoso)
(sigue, sigue)

[Final Chorus]
Pantera, pantera
me muevo pa’ robar
Pantera, pantera
nadie me va a pillar

Pantera, pantera
con swing de barrio y sal
Pantera, pantera
me río y me voy ya

Pantera, pantera
me muevo pa’ robar
Pantera, pantera
nadie me va a pillar
